scripts.db:seed: mkdir -p .wrangler && tsx scripts/seed.ts --dev > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute prana --local --file=.wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.e2e:serve: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e && mkdir -p .wrangler && wrangler d1 migrations apply prana --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && tsx scripts/seed.ts --dev > .wrangler/e2e-seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute prana --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --file=.wrangler/e2e-seed.sql && wrangler dev --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --var FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR:true
